title.purpose: Card titles and admin page headers.

mono.purpose: IDs, tokens, credit counts, code only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action. Record Red fill, scarce by doctrine.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23); color: oklch(1 0 0); font: 500 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action: hairline border, fills with accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.2 0 0); font: 500 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0 0); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.95 0.02 29.23); color: oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23 / 0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bench-gray fill for the calmer of two adjacent actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: oklch(0.96 0 0); color: oklch(0.2 0 0); font: 500 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.96 0 0 / 0.8); }

components.name: Default Badge
components.description: Status / count pill. Use StatusBadge for status mapping.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; background: oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23); color: oklch(1 0 0); font: 500 0.75rem Inter, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Outline Badge
components.description: Neutral status pill for non-terminal states.
components.css: .ds-badge-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.2 0 0); font: 500 0.75rem Inter, sans-serif; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0 0); border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field. Transparent fill, red focus halo.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.2 0 0); font: 400 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0 0); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.45 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.628 0.258 29.23 / 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting container. Off-white over page white, hairline border, faint shadow. Never nested.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 24px; background: oklch(0.985 0 0); color: oklch(0.2 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0 0); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-card-title { font: 500 0.75rem Inter, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.45 0 0); } .ds-card-value { font: 700 1.5rem Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.name: Mention Pill
components.description: Inline @-mention tag in the agent prompt editor. Violet=person, green=inspiration, amber=image.
components.css: .ds-mention { display: inline; padding: 0.05rem 0.3rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; font: 500 inherit/inherit Inter, sans-serif; background: oklch(0.55 0.2 290 / 0.15); color: oklch(0.75 0.16 290); border: 1px solid oklch(0.55 0.2 290 / 0.25); }

narrative.overview: Thumbfa.st is a fast editing bench, not a showroom. Surfaces stay near-monochrome on purpose; the only saturated thing that belongs on screen is the creator's own thumbnail output and the one decisive red the brand owns. Red is the record light: it marks the live action and the single destructive cut, never wallpaper. Density lives where data matters, calm everywhere else. The tool should disappear into the task.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome chrome so colorful thumbnail output is the only loud element.
One brand red, scarce by doctrine, for primary actions, selection, focus, and true destruction only.
Token-driven semantic color; never hardcoded hex.
Dense where data matters, calm everywhere else.
Light and dark themes from one OKLCH token set.
Lucide icons only. No emojis. No gradients.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Record Red has exactly two jobs: the primary action and the one destructive action. The overlap is intentional scarcity. Red for anything else (decoration, headings, chart fills, non-primary CTAs) is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Blue-Default Rule
rules.body: info blue exists for informational states only. The accent of this system is red and the neutral is gray; blue-*, sky-*, cyan-*, indigo-* as a generic accent are forbidden.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter does the work. Hierarchy is weight and size, not a new typeface. No second sans, display face, or brand font in product/admin UI.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono only for machine values: IDs, tokens, credit counts, code. Never body or labels for flavor.

rules.name: The Hairline-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a 1px border or a tonal step before a shadow. A 2014-era drop shadow under a card is too dark and too tight; use the border.

dos: Do treat shadcn semantic tokens as the source of truth; use the variant, not a hardcoded color.
Do keep Record Red scarce: primary action and true destruction only.
Do build admin/data surfaces from the shared admin-shared.tsx kit.
Do ship a skeleton that mirrors the real layout and an empty state that teaches the interface.
Do put edits in dialogs (dialogManager + TanStack Form) and keep reading inline and dense.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Rule Line or tonal step before a shadow.
Do use Lucide icons and aria-label every icon-only button.
donts: Don't use gradients or glassmorphism anywhere. No glowing hero-metric cards.
Don't ship the generic AI-tool look: purple gradients, sparkle icons, neon accents.
Don't use marketing tone or hype language inside the product or admin.
Don't introduce blue-*, sky-*, cyan-*, or indigo-* as a generic accent.
Don't use Record Red for decoration, headings, chart fills, or non-primary CTAs.
Don't nest cards, fork a one-off admin component, or hand-roll a status badge.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't lighten muted-foreground or placeholder text below ~4.5:1.
Don't use emojis in the UI; use a Lucide icon.
